integrity: The infinite-m theorem follows analytically from exact interval-covering, fixed-point sign and entropy-product identities. Finite exact-rational tests are supporting checks, not an infinite proof. Historical priority is not independently audited.
limitations: Continuous piecewise-affine controller dependence; parameter Lipschitz constant grows with m. Infinite-batch unit learning step only. Exact entropy is for an invariant subsystem; full entropy has only a lower bound. Local, not global, attraction; no finite-sample noise theorem.
title: Arbitrarily high adaptive entropy despite instantaneous frozen mixing and a unique attracting equilibrium
